remarks:
Williamsville Schools with Clarence taxes! Welcome to 8030 Old Post Road West in the highly sought after Farmington Woods neighborhood! Situated on a picturesque 0.91-acre lot surrounded by mature trees with no rear neighbors, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers privacy and a beautiful park-like setting. The spacious living room features vaulted ceilings, a wood-burning fireplace with gas start, and a built-in workspace ideal for a home office or homework station. A sun-filled formal dining room leads to a well-appointed kitchen featuring Corian countertops, built-in Thermador gas cooktop, double wall ovens, pantry, and separate eat-in area. Both the living room and kitchen feature Pella sliding glass doors opening to an adjoining 16-foot-wide rear deck, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living and an ideal setting for entertaining. Convenient first-floor laundry with Speed Queen W+D, along with a half bath, complete the main level.

Upstairs, the primary suite boasts more vaulted ceilings, an expansive walk-in closet, and an en suite bath with Jacuzzi soaking tub, double vanity, and separate walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. 

The oversized, partially finished basement provides flexible space for recreation or storage. Additional highlights include brand-new carpeting throughout, updated mechanicals, 150-amp electrical service, a two-car garage with additional storage, and a charming rounded front porch with newly stamped concrete. Enjoy nearly an acre of peaceful surroundings in one of East Amherst's most desirable neighborhoods!



Open Houses: Thursday, October 22, from 5:00–7:00 PM and Sunday, October 25, from 12:00–2:00 PM.
